questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How football teams prepare for a tournament
Different feelings people have about the World Cup
Why Russia was chosen to host the World Cup
The history of the World Cup mascot
questions.why: They hear from people with different viewpoints, some excited and some not, about the World Cup.

questions.q: How do Neil and Rob feel about the World Cup?
options: Both are very excited
Both are completely uninterested
Neil is very excited, but Rob is only a little interested
Rob is very excited about it, but Neil isn't really interested
questions.why: Neil says he's very excited, while Rob will 'just be taking a passing interest'.

questions.q: Who won the previous World Cup in 2014, according to Rob?
options: Argentina
Brazil
Iceland
Germany
questions.why: Rob says it was Germany, and they beat Lionel Messi's Argentina in the final.

questions.q: Apart from the football itself, what does Keith enjoy about the World Cup?
options: Learning about teams and stories from around the world
Meeting famous players
Travelling to other countries to watch the matches
Winning money on bets
questions.why: He says you get to know about teams in other parts of the world and the stories off the pitch.

questions.q: What does Jane enjoy seeing in the tournament?
options: The favourites winning easily
Weaker teams doing surprisingly well
Her own team winning
Famous players scoring goals
questions.why: Jane says it's great 'to see the underdogs that are going to come through'.

questions.q: Why is Jeff not excited about the World Cup?
options: He thinks football lacks fair play and is too corporate
He can't afford the tickets
His team isn't playing
The matches are on too late at night for him to watch them
questions.why: He says there's not a lot of sportsmanship, it's very corporate and there's cheating.

questions.q: What is Inga's view of the World Cup?
options: It is the best event in the world
It is too expensive to watch on TV or at the stadium
It is too long
There is too much excitement about nothing
questions.why: Inga says 'It's just too much hype about nothing really.'

questions.q: Why does Rob call Jeff and Inga 'sensible people'?
options: Because they know a lot about football and the players
Because they support England
Like him, they aren't excited about the World Cup
Because they gave the right quiz answer
questions.why: Rob isn't very interested in the World Cup, so he agrees with the people who aren't bothered.
